name: Brewing stands
note: Brewing stands take blaze powder as fuel for 20 brews, brew for 400 ticks each bottle that mixes with the ingredient into its mix (every mix of both official servers' brewing reports), stop when the ingredient changes or nothing is left to brew, throw out dragon's breath's glass bottle, show their bottles, take from and give to hoppers by face and drive comparators, as both official servers do tick by tick (with the official data packs); players use their menus as on both official servers, and a brewed bottle is a new one of its mix without the old one's other components
